task.description: Produce EXT-01 test specification artifacts covering the SERVICE_TASK node type end to end. Create/ अपडेट test spec content for unit and integration coverage of activation validation, URL/method/header construction, timeout handling, redirect rejection, retry/backoff behavior, success-path JSON object merge, invalid 2xx-body ERROR transition, trace/idempotency header propagation, and DLQ/EE-10 terminal handling. Include explicit test cases for the empty resolved URL template edge case and non-JSON 2xx body behavior. Ensure traceability from each EXT-01 acceptance criterion and edge case to test IDs, test layers, and required fixtures/data. Write only test specifications and related test artifacts, no implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All EXT-01 acceptance criteria map to test cases
Unit and integration coverage are both specified
Edge cases are explicit, including empty URL template and invalid 2xx body
Traceability matrix links test IDs to requirements and modules
Artifacts are written under tests/specs/ or tests/ as appropriate

result.summary: Created the EXT-01 test specification with explicit unit and integration coverage for SERVICE_TASK activation validation, request construction, timeout and retry policy, redirect and 429 failure handling, success-path merge behavior, invalid 2xx body rejection, trace and idempotency propagation, and terminal DLQ + ERROR handling.
